title: Customer
description: A customer account record as stored by the accounts service and exchanged over the sync API. Records are soft-deleted, never physically removed by API calls.

id.description: Immutable account identifier assigned at signup; ULID-formatted and safe to use as a foreign key.

email.description: Primary contact address; must be unique across all active customers. Uniqueness is enforced case-insensitively at write time, and a conflicting write is rejected with a uniqueness violation rather than silently merging accounts. Soft-deleted customers release their address for reuse.

displayName.description: Name shown in dashboards and receipts. Free text; trailing whitespace is trimmed on write.

billingAddress.description: Address used on invoices. Validated more strictly than the shipping address: it must geocode to a deliverable location before invoicing is enabled.

shippingAddresses.description: Saved shipping destinations, at most 10 per customer. The first entry is treated as the default at checkout.

marketingOptIn.description: Whether the customer agreed to marketing email. Defaults to false and may only be set true by an explicit consent event; imports cannot flip it.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of account creation in UTC.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete marker: when a customer is deleted, deletedAt is set instead of removing the row, and the record stops appearing in list responses while remaining readable by direct id lookup for audit purposes. A null value means the account is active.

Address.description: A postal address. line1 and countryCode are always required; region is required only for countries that use subdivisions, such as US states or Canadian provinces.

line1.description: Street address including house number. Post office boxes are rejected for shipping addresses but allowed for billing.

region.description: State, province, or subdivision code where the country requires one.

postalCode.description: Postal code; must match the national format of the country given in countryCode, for example five digits or ZIP+4 for US addresses. Validation happens on write and invalid codes reject the whole address.
